image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a ripe fig cut in half, revealing its interior. The fruit has a dark purple/black skin and a vibrant red/pink fleshy pulp filled with numerous small, pale seeds. The texture appears moist and jam-like. The background is blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field, with hints of a metallic or reflective surface below the fruit.
